title: Paper on why UFOs appear near nuclear sites: spacetime disturbances

tellings.quote: >> I've written I've written a paper about that that if it's true shows that it has nothing to do with that at all as to why they show up.

plain: A retired Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says he has written a paper explaining why UFOs show up near nuclear sites such as Chernobyl, and that if it is right the reason "has nothing to do with" what people usually assume. He tells Michels the real cause is disturbances in spacetime around such places, not interest in the weapons or reactors themselves, which would change what the many sightings near nuclear sites mean.
